A 'LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse' variant (sparse attention, 1M ctx, arXiv 2608.01662, Aug 2026) exists - not modelled separately. Meituan's current gen is LongCat 2.0 (1.6T, out of range).

models.name: Gemini 4 Carbon
models.note: First released 2026-10-28 as a restricted model (Google Fairwind program for cyber defenders). Generally available since 2026-11-10 ('Gemini 4 Carbon is now available'): Gemini API paid tier in Google AI Studio and Android Studio, Gemini for business, Google Antigravity and CodeMender for paying developers and enterprises; rolling out to Google AI Ultra subscribers in the Gemini app, AI Mode and Antigravity; also listed on OpenRouter as google/gemini-4-carbon (Google Vertex and AI Studio) since 2026-11-10. The public model ships with cyber safeguards; 'Carbon for cyber' remains limited to the Fairwind program. Introductory price $2/$10 per 1M (same as Argon) until 2026-11-30, then $4/$20. Up to 1M tokens of input and output combined (OpenRouter lists 1,048,576), thinking levels low/medium/high, knowledge cutoff March 2026 per the model card (published November 2026).

models.name: Nanbeige4.3-33B
models.note: Apache-2.0; own base (Nanbeige4.3-33B-Base), not a fine-tune. HF repo created 2026-10-24, AI Weekly alert 10-25 -> released 3 days before this window and missed by the 10-28 run. Thinking on by default (preserve_thinking option), 512K context (262K max for reasoning). HF trending #3. Vendor attribution to BOSS Zhipin from AI Weekly FR; card says Nanbeige LLM Lab.

models.name: LongCat-2.5
models.note: Native multimodal MoE, 1.6T total (~48B active; HF safetensors metadata 1.78T), built for long-horizon agentic coding; trained on Chinese domestic chips, W4A4 expert quantization (W4A4KV8 variant), hybrid thinking on/off. API release 2026-11-02 (HN launch thread 50337716). MIT-licensed weights on Hugging Face meituan-longcat/LongCat-2.5 and LongCat-2.5-W4A4: repo created 2026-11-04, shards uploaded 11-04/11-05, model card finalised 2026-11-05 ~08:13Z and updated 11-09 (public and ungated as of 2026-11-10; exact go-public time not visible). Price $0.30/$1.20 per 1M and 1M context/131K output per llm-stats. Replaces longcat-2.0 as Meituan flagship. LongCat-2.5-Preview (different checkpoint, API since 2026-09-25) not aliased.

models.name: Hy4
models.note: Official Hy4 (successor of Hy4 preview), released 2026-11-04: first Hunyuan model with vision + computer use; 770B MoE per Caixin/ChainCatcher (active count not restated; preview was 770B-A49B). Weights + system card promised 'in the coming days' but still not on Hugging Face (tencent org) as of 2026-11-13. API id hy4 (TokenHub, OpenRouter tencent/hy4): list price RMB 6/18 per 1M (~US$0.90/2.70 per Tencent; OpenRouter list $0.834/$2.501), unchanged from preview; 50% promotional discount on TokenHub/OpenRouter to 2026-12-31 (OpenRouter now bills $0.417/$1.2505). After launch-day rate limiting Tencent expanded Hy4 inference capacity tenfold and raised free quotas (announced 2026-11-05). 1M context, 64K max output. Hy4 Flash announced as coming soon.

models.name: Ripple-65B Preview
models.note: Trained from scratch by Ricursive Intelligence (chip-design AI lab; not the 'Recursive' Flint vendor): dense 80-layer, d_model 5120, 12T pretraining tokens, up to 1M context; Apache-2.0 weights on HF ricursiveAI/Ripple-65B-Preview (BF16, also NVFP4/DFlash2 variants; HF created 2026-11-04). Claims US open-weight SOTA on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (80.52). Hosted on Together, GMI, OpenRouter ($0.20/$0.60 per 1M; OpenRouter now lists 1,048,576 context, up from 16,384 at launch).

models.name: Claude Fable 5.2
models.note: Successor of Fable 5.1, released 2026-11-09 and generally available (Claude API, Bedrock anthropic.claude-fable-5-2, Google Cloud, Microsoft Foundry, OpenRouter anthropic/claude-fable-5.2). $8/$40 per 1M (Fable 5.1: $10/$50); cache read $0.20, 5m/1h cache write $10/$16; fast mode $16/$80; batch 50% off. 1M context, 128K max output; adaptive thinking always on; default effort high on the API (medium in Claude apps and Claude Code); knowledge cutoff Jun 2026. Same capabilities as the restricted Mythos 5.2, with safeguards on.

models.name: Claude Mythos 5.2
models.note: Restricted release (2026-11-09): only for organizations verified through Anthropic's Cyber Verification Program or Life Sciences Verification Program, and inside Claude Security for Claude Enterprise. Per Anthropic docs it shares Fable 5.2's specifications and pricing ($8/$40 per 1M, 1M context, 128K output).

models.name: Muse Ember
models.note: Meta's smallest and most efficient Muse model, the first trained using Muse Wonder Full; closed weights, parameter count not disclosed. Meta Model API id muse-ember-1.0 (Responses API), Muse Code, Google Cloud, Oracle Cloud, OpenRouter meta/muse-ember. $0.10/$0.50 per 1M for prompts up to 200K tokens ($0.30/$1.50 above; cached input $0.004/$0.012). 1M context, up to 512K output. Effort list = generic Meta API values minus 'none' (launch charts show medium to max). Does not replace the open-weight Muse Glimmer (small line, gen1). OpenRouter's stealth model 'Crouton Alpha' (listed 2026-11-03, stealth period now ended) was an early version of Muse Ember according to OpenRouter; it is not aliased because it is a different checkpoint.

models.name: Inkling 2 Small
models.note: Second-generation Inkling: 594B total / 17B active MoE with image input (292M vision encoder based on Perception Encoder) and variable reasoning effort (launch evals at effort 0.99 = xhigh). Released 2026-11-05 on Tinker for sampling and fine-tuning under Tinker terms; serverless inference beta $0.30/$1.00 per 1M (cached input $0.03) with 64K/256K context tiers; model card context up to 1M tokens. Listed on OpenRouter as thinkingmachines/inkling-2-small:free since 2026-11-09 (free of charge, 1,048,576 context, Thinking Machines as the only provider). Weights were promised under Apache-2.0 'next week' after external safety testing; they are still not on Hugging Face (thinkingmachines org) as of 2026-11-13 and the launch post has no update. Replaces Inkling Small (266B-A12B) in the vendor's small line.

models.name: Ling 3.2 Flash
models.note: Native multimodal successor of Ling 3.1 Flash at the same size (560B total / 25B active): text, image and video input, 1M context; aimed at complex visual understanding, multimodal long-horizon agents, 3D understanding and interaction, and medical multimodal tasks. Launched 2026-11-05 (Ant Ling changelog v2.0.6) in the chat interface and through OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs, free for the first two weeks; no list price published. No weights on Hugging Face (inclusionAI) as of 2026-11-11 and no open-weight plan stated. Released before this run's 11-09..11-11 window; earlier runs missed it. new_generation is left false because InclusionAI's flagship line holds two families (Ling and Ring).

models.name: Spark X2.6
models.note: Cloud flagship of iFLYTEK's Spark X2.6 device-cloud series, announced 2026-10-22 at the iFLYTEK 1024 Global Developer Festival: 293B total / about 30B active MoE, 1M context, trained on iFLYTEK's domestic compute; successor of Spark X2.5 (September 2026). API on the iFLYTEK Xingchen MaaS platform (maas.xfyun.cn): list price RMB 1.5/6 per 1M tokens (about US$0.21/0.85 at 7.05 RMB/USD), launch discount RMB 0.9/3.6 (about US$0.13/0.51), cached input RMB 0.08. Weights of the cloud model are not public; only the on-device Spark-X2.6-4B and -1.7B (below the 5B cut-off) are open under Apache-2.0 on Hugging Face (org XHToken, GitHub XHToken/Spark-X2.6). Some coverage (Global Times) calls the release 'open-sourced' without separating the two. Company-reported results only (ranked first on SWE Pro and SWE Multilingual, second on SWE Verified; no scores published). The Arena WebDev entry 'Spark-X2.6' (1484.8 on 2026-11-10) is presumably this cloud model. Vendor confirmed as iFLYTEK from the press release and Chinese tech press; the label 'synlan' was not found in any source, and Arena's organisation field could not be read. Released before this run's window; added because the maintainers asked for it to be checked.

models.name: U2 Flash
models.note: Unisound (HKEX 09678) released U2-Flash on 2026-09-15, according to same-day reports of the company's announcement (Caiwen, Zhitong Finance): a sparse MoE model with about 266B total / about 10B active parameters, post-trained from the company's U2 base model. Unisound's model page lists a 1M context window, 128K maximum output, text input and output, and four thinking levels (none/low/high/max), served through its MaaS platform with OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs. Price is still not confirmed by a vendor page: QbitAI (2026-09-17) reported a limited-time rate of RMB 0.6 / 1.2 per 1M input / output tokens (described as 60% of list; cached input RMB 0.12) and free quota from Sep 15 to 30, and called the context 512K at that time. Vendor-reported scores on the model page: DeepSWE v1.1 64.6, SWE-Bench Pro 61.6, TerminalBench 3.0 24.3, HMMT Feb. 2026 97.1, IMOAnswerBench 90.3, GPQA-Diamond 92.4. Also on the Arena WebDev leaderboard (organisation 'unisound', license 'Proprietary').

models.name: Gemini 4 Hydrogen
models.note: Released 2026-11-12 ('Introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen'): the workhorse model of the Gemini 4 family, positioned as the upgrade for teams migrating from Gemini 3.8 Flash. Rolling out the same day in the Gemini API (Google AI Studio, Android Studio), Gemini for business, Google Antigravity (paid AI Pro and Ultra), Gemini in Sheets, the Gemini app model picker and Google Search; also on OpenRouter as google/gemini-4-hydrogen. $1.50/$7.50 per 1M tokens, flat across the 1M window (the same as Gemini 3.8 Flash's non-introductory price; OpenRouter batch variant $0.75/$3.75). Combined input-output window up to 1M tokens (OpenRouter lists 1,048,576); 64K default synchronous output, up to 1M with background long decode. Thinking levels low/medium/high (default)/xhigh; text, image, audio and video input; knowledge cutoff March 2026 per the model card. The post does not say whether this is a preview or a GA release. Antigravity's new Orchestrator pairs it with Gemini 4 Carbon.

models.name: ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview
models.note: Baidu's product-update post of 2026-11-11 introduces ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview as the first post-trained model built on its ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base checkpoint (a pretraining checkpoint on Hugging Face since 2026-11-05, not tracked): 280B total / 14B active parameters, 1M-token context, text-only. API on Baidu Qianfan; listed on OpenRouter as baidu/ernie-5.5-flash-preview:free since 2026-11-10 UTC (free of charge, 1,024,000 context, up to 921,600 output). No list price published. Baidu says the weights will be open-sourced under Apache 2.0 'soon'; on 2026-11-13 the baidu organisation on Hugging Face holds only the two Flash-Base repositories.
